senses.zh: 他們就要從高山頂上下來
senses.en: They are coming down from the top of the mountain.

《巴宰語詞典》p.155，kizih- 條下派生詞

records.text: isia lai ki paakizihay inapa a buzux rawil

senses.en: He put down the bow and arrows carried on his back.

records.text: isia lai ki naki a paakizihay buzux u rawil

senses.en: I released my bow and arrows.

records.text: pakizih la nisia a iniliw laiki saw a isia i

senses.zh: 那個人放下他所挑的東西
senses.en: That person put down what he was carrying.

records.text: lia ka ina isia ka, pakizihen paidemen di batu babaw lia ki rakihan

senses.zh: 然後母親解下嬰兒，讓他在岩石上睡覺
senses.en: Then the mother released the baby and let him sleep on the rock.
